verdict.rationale: Logseq ships a local HTTP APIs server for external access to the graph and a plugin API (community-documented) plus a logseq:// protocol for triggering actions, showing real programmatic access exists. However there is no evidence of a formal API spec (probes for openapi/swagger returned 404) or documentation claiming full feature parity between API/plugin capabilities and the UI, so the 'everything' claim is unverified. Missing for 10: a documented complete API surface covering all UI actions, an OpenAPI/spec reference, and evidence of parity beyond graph read/write and plugin hooks.
